note: The frozen half of the task. Nothing a submission says may move any number in this file. The verifier reads its own copy of it at grading time.

budget.note: The compute budget is FIXED in tokens and in forward/backward passes. A recipe chooses how many micro-batches accumulate into one optimizer step; it cannot change how many micro-batches are run. Every recipe therefore costs the same FLOPs and very nearly the same wall clock.

init.note: Every run in this task starts from the same parameter tensors. The optimizer recipe is the only thing that differs between two runs.

evaluation.metric: mean token-level cross-entropy in nats, lower is better
evaluation.note: The graded split is NOT in the agent image. environment/data/devset_slice.bin is a proxy cut from a different training shard and is the agent's own yardstick; it is never the graded number.

data.format: FineWeb10B GPT-2 BPE. 1024-byte int32 header (magic 20240520, version 1, token count), then uint16 token ids.
data.train_slice_note: Exactly the 25165824 tokens the budget consumes, plus one for the shifted target. There is no extra training data to find.
